description:
Search the organization's skills, its playbooks for how it does things, before starting a task. Call this at the start of any task the organization may have a way of doing, Valet work or not, with words from the task, and whenever the user names a skill your client does not have: "use the duck skill" may mean one of these. Then read each skill whose description applies with get_skill before starting.

Matches the words of query against each skill's name and description and returns the best matches, at most five, with the sentence saying when each applies. An empty answer means no skill matched those words, not that the organization has none: list_skills names them all. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to search. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

query.description: Required. Words from the task or the skill's name, such as "quarterly close" or "duck".

name: find_skill
title: Find an organization skill
